name: microsoft-workiq
description: Search and work with Microsoft 365 mail, meetings, files and Teams context through Microsoft’s official Work IQ MCP. Requires tenant setup and your own Entra app.

descriptions.en: Search and work with Microsoft 365 mail, meetings, files and Teams context through Microsoft’s official Work IQ MCP. Requires tenant setup and your own Entra app.
descriptions.zh-CN: 通过微软官方 Work IQ MCP 检索和处理 Microsoft 365 邮件、会议、文件与 Teams 工作上下文。需要租户配置和自有 Entra 应用。
